capabilities: display the time in the status bar
optionally show the date alongside the time
extras: The custom-format documentation is only linked, not included; the README notes the plugin was made while migrating the author's notes to Obsidian.
intentEvidence: A rather simple plugin that displays the time (and date, if you desire) on your status bar.
motivation: The author built it to dabble with the Obsidian API while migrating their notes to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's status bar does not display a clock or the current date.
summary: Status bar clock that shows the time, and optionally the date, in a predefined or custom format.
